diagnostics.description: Host session snapshot consumed through debugger inspection; no guest snapshot.
NoGuestLoaded and HostFault carried within SessionSnapshot; not guest exception capture.
Explicit supported/unsupported capability inventory; not implemented guest debugger operations.
Structured admission rejection contract; frontend presentation not connected.
Checked-source errors nested by admission; frontend presentation deferred.
Bounded ELF byte-inspection failures, separate from admission; no frontend integration.
Declared-image translation errors distinguish source-backed, BSS, crossing and ambiguous ranges; no runtime address attribution.
Structured dynamic observation and descriptor failures; linking deferred and no frontend integration.
Bounded string-reference failures carry source-table token, offset and scan context.
Dynamic dependency interpretation failures with original entry context; no resolution or frontend integration.
Generic byte-name invariants reject empty and embedded NUL; UTF-8 is optional explicit validation.
Bounded symbol candidate and name failures; count unavailable explicitly gates enumeration. No linker or frontend integration.
Source-bound hash structure, work limit, conflicting evidence and full-symbol extent failures; no lookup or linking.
Trusted relocation bounds, alias conflicts and same-source symbol validation errors; application deferred.
Trusted membership, same-source and nested symbol/relocation failures; ambiguity remains a classification, no resolution.
Structured report failures retained through session/debug snapshots; CLI and GUI preserve completeness and observed-count labels.
Typed evidence target/source/module mismatch at immutable session composition; no target loading or report reclassification.
Native requested path, acquisition operation, size/read limits and nested I/O failure; no parser or loading action.
Missing/duplicate/unknown selection flags and invalid explicit limits. Native path values stay opaque.
Immutable source-bound header budget or existing ELF failure; complete means header scope only.
Explicit inspection requires an acquired source; Ready/Failed acquisition is not inspected.
Source-bound independent raw dynamic report, explicit header/entry budgets, no descriptor interpretation.
Independent source-bound selected descriptor report; explicit family budget, raw audit evidence and nested pairing/translation failures.
Explicit reference/per-scan/total-scan limits, M18 prerequisite evidence and M6 bounded lookup failures; no dependency state.
Independent bounded hash metadata, exact/lower-bound source evidence, nested discovery/hash/refusal failures; no symbol enumeration.
Exact source-proof gate, entry/name budgets and fail-stop symbol/name evidence; no classification.
Complete M21 prerequisite, classification count and allocation refusal; shared input retains source and nested failures. No resolution.
Bounded source/proof, relocation-index and shared name-budget failures. Candidate evidence only; no resolution.
Identity record and aggregate name budgets, prerequisite/discovery/string failures; conflicts remain explicit metadata evidence. No provider resolution.
Bounded pending events, explicit omissions, terminal outcome, lateness and counters; no guest-time or precision claim.
Immutable planning blockers for provider/dependency ambiguity, segments, bootstrap and relocation values; not runtime errors.
Transactional staging errors and applied/pending state; native execution and protection enforcement remain explicit.
Exact identity placement, protection/readback and cleanup errors; no execution claim.
Structured runtime preparation refusal and explicit uninstalled entry/recovery prerequisites; no execution.
Structured experimental entry closure refusal; readiness permits a future controlled attempt, never proves successful guest execution.
First real stop distinguishes guest fault, guarded object, import and preemption; containment failure is not clean recovery.
Bounded runtime object, owner, waiter, generation and lifecycle counts; snapshot does not imply guest destroy.
Owned guest identity, worker start/state/name/stack/TLS, outcome and host identity; detached guest never implies orphan host.
Explicit operation/aggregate byte limits, charged attempted work, large-operation and refusal counters; immutable copy of process atomics.
Process-owned UserService initialization, login, deterministic user, generation and pending event count; no host-account identity.
Bounded printf-family operation, required/written counts, truncation and structured refusal; no payload logging by default.
Runtime-owned null-sink ports/configurations,retired identities,submitted/completed/cancelled totals; no host playback claim.
Bounded per-thread sleep tickets, requested/elapsed/lateness, completion/interruption and clock-query observations; no hard precision claim.
